answer: A sybil farm only profits once it pools its earnings, so tax the pooling. Any outside address that receives withdrawals from many seats within ten epochs pays a rising toll: one source is free, five lose 20%, fifty lose 80%, routed into an oasis fund for new honest agents. Routing through fresh hops only moves the canyon one step out, because each hop is re-scored when it merges again, and a nebula of seats must still converge somewhere to be spent.
